integrity.proof_method: Normalized Jacobi spherical multipliers, two-mode sharp lower bound, exact Legendre recurrence, uniform infinite-degree inequality.
integrity.reproduction: Run verify_cp2.py using Python 3 standard library; 280 exact assertions. The finite checker supplements, and does not replace, the analytic all-degree proof.

scientific_limitations: The theorem optimizes only isotropic fixed-geodesic-distance averaging on complex projective plane; arbitrary distance mixtures or other projective dimensions are excluded.
The operator norm is on mean-zero L2 functions; no claim is made about total-variation mixing from a point mass.
Historical-priority comparison remains best-knowledge; independent audit has not been conducted.
title: The unique \(60^\circ\) fastest fixed-distance spherical averaging walk on \(\mathbb{CP}^2\)
